candidate.note: v0.5.0 release candidate after the docs-only correction commit c0066d95 (third-party notice, Workspace owner docs, GUIDE, READMEs, VERIFICATION acceptance-map rows). This receipt supersedes the earlier 236d7362 receipt: those docs are packaged files, so per the AGENTS.md merge-gate rule a new clean baseline was created and all thirteen gates were re-run on this SHA rather than carried over. `git status --porcelain` was empty before the gates and HEAD was unchanged after them; `npm run build` reproduced the tracked dist/ byte-for-byte, and the packaged artifact grew from 310 to 311 files, which is exactly the corrected documentation. Only docs/verification receipt files change afterwards. No push, tag, release or installed-plugin update is performed by this receipt.

releaseConclusion: All thirteen gates PASS on the clean, docs-corrected v0.5.0 candidate c0066d95: typecheck, a build that reproduced the tracked dist/, 98 files / 1015 Vitest tests, 26 Codex slices, 105 total slices, installer, marketplace, packaged runtime (memex-0.5.0.tgz, 311 files, 9 MCP tools), offline lifecycle 9/9, the real-Chrome Memex Workspace E2E (10 check groups, 0 runtime errors), 82 Workspace unit tests and the benchmark contract. Isolated plugin validation passes all 11 substitute checks with matching 0.5.0 plugin and MCP server versions, and is PASS-WITH-NOTES only because the formal `codex plugin validate` subcommand does not exist in codex-cli 0.153.4. Every gate was re-executed on this SHA rather than inherited from the superseded 236d7362 receipt, because the documentation corrected by c0066d95 ships inside the package — the artifact grew from 310 to 311 files. The full acceptance benchmark was NOT re-run: it is referenced as prior evidence measured on 236d7362 (PASS, 6/6 AC_PERF groups, knowledge map through `loopback HTTP /api/v2/graph` with 50 nodes and 49 edges on the native LOCAL WEBGL renderer), and the contract gate confirms that report still satisfies the committed contract. Live user data, an authenticated Codex tier run, the formal plugin validator, benchmark numbers for this exact SHA, real-world performance, model quality and the prose accuracy of the corrected docs are NOT_PROVEN.
